name: speedi-availability
description: Speedi is a live-availability network for UK tradespeople and local services. Providers set their own traffic light and it expires on a timer, so a green light means the business said it was free recently rather than that it merely exists in a directory. Ask for a trade in a postcode, or describe the job in plain words, and Speedi answers with who is actually free, how far away they are, and whether the business set that status itself.

interface.longDescription:
Speedi finds local tradespeople and service businesses who are available right now, and shows how to contact them directly.

Speedi is a live-availability network for UK tradespeople and local services — plumbers, electricians and roofers, but equally mobile valeting, aesthetics, couriers, airport transfers, cleaners and dog walkers.

It is not a directory. Every provider sets their own traffic light, and that light expires on a timer, so a green light means the business said it was free recently rather than that it exists somewhere in a database. Where Speedi does not know, it says so plainly rather than implying a business is unavailable.

Ask for a trade near a postcode, or just describe the problem — "my boiler won't fire up, anyone available in Chorley" — and Speedi resolves the job to the right trade, returns who is free now, how far away they are, and whether the business set that status itself. You can also ask to be told the moment a particular business becomes free, cancellations included.

No payment is taken and nothing is booked through the connector: every result links to the business's own Speedi profile, where the customer contacts them directly.

publication.release_notes: First release. Find UK tradespeople and local services who are free right now, by trade and postcode or by describing the job in plain words. Returns live availability set by the business itself, with distance and a link to their profile. Also supports asking to be notified the moment a named business becomes free.

positive.description: Plain search for a trade near a UK postcode.
positive.prompt: Who's free near PR7 1AA right now? I need a plumber.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns plumbers within 10 miles of Chorley, separating those free right now from those on Speedi but busy, with distance for each and whether the business set its own light.

positive.description: The job described in plain words, with no trade named.
positive.prompt: My boiler won't fire up, is anyone available near PR7 1AA?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the described fault to the trade Boiler Repair rather than searching for nothing, returns boiler and heating engineers, and says in passing which trade it searched so the person can redirect it.

positive.description: A local service rather than a building trade.
positive.prompt: Any mobile car valeting available near PR1 1AA?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns mobile valeting businesses near Preston, showing the network covers services and not only construction trades.

positive.prompt: Is Speedi Boiler Repair free at the moment?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns that one business with its current light and when it was set, stating what Speedi knows rather than making a claim about the business.
Returns up to 20 results, each with an id, a title carrying trade, availability and distance, and a non-empty https url to that business's profile.

negative.description: No location given — must ask for a postcode rather than guess an area.
An area with no coverage — must say so honestly rather than return unrelated businesses.
negative.prompt: Is there a plumber available near IV51 9AA on the Isle of Skye?

negative.description: A business that does not exist — must not substitute a different one.
negative.prompt: Is Zzz Nonexistent Trading Ltd available near PR7 1AA?
